name: D2R Simple Loot Filter
description: A simple loot filter originally created by Cbraqz; edited/fixed/modified and converted to D2RMM by kabobist
author: Cbraqz - kabobist - ChrisTitusTech

config.name: Toggle All
config.description: Toggles all the changes - Side note: if you want to play online add -mod lootfilter -txt to your additional parameters in the battle.net launcher and launch it there instead of lootfilter.

children.name: Item Names (item-names.json)
children.description: This is where the majority of the action happens, preferably keep it enabled.

children.name: Item Modifiers (item-modifiers.json)
children.description: This is the modifiers for items, FCR, FHR, Cold Resist, etc.

children.name: Item Name Affixes (item-nameaffixes.json)
children.description: This just blacks out damaged, crude, etc items with a grey dot at the beginning.

children.name: Item Runes (item-runes.json)
children.description: This is where we modify runes, as the name suggests.
